ops.title: Use a stable Darwin boot identity for ownership and safe live transitions
ops.description:
Owner: Core installer/source lane (core109_load_delivery), accountable to Root. Investigation only; no product source writer or runtime authority assigned by this task.

Evidence: Capt28 fullguard c6c5234c (2026-11-01T07:58:08Z), retained diagnosis87b24af3. Actual26 host80993 native PID/start and all15 worker PID/start/PPID/PGID/SID match durable records. Record boot1792752415023651 differs from current kern.boottime1792752415080072 by56,421us. Guard excludes records as cross-boot. Independent protected Claude78037/child78063 under worker81371 remains a separate HOLD. Cause/actor of actual token change UNKNOWN; no NTP or reboot attribution.

Primary Apple source pinned f6217f891ac0bb64f3d375211650a4c1ff8ca1ea: clock.c767/787/797 adjusts clock_boottime on calendar set; kern_sysctl.c2921 exposes read-only kern.bootsessionuuid. Source receipt FE/apple-boot-identity-source/source-receipt.json. daemonkit0.36.1 internal/proc/probe_darwin.go79 uses kern.boottime; Observe/reap classify crossboot before PID probe. No new deployment permission is conveyed. Actual Capt26/SDK33 remains installed; genuine28 SDK34 public is ready but HOLD, tail29 publication owner separate. Core retains sole matching App installer; Code1258032 and CCX923 cases remain separately owned/unrun. Evidence/metadata only.
